text:
Dear Larkspur team,

I hope this email finds you well. I am writing to inquire about hiring your Brightwater for our company launch event. We are interested in renting it for a period, which would begin on Thu 18 Mar 2027 at 09:30 and conclude on 20 March 2027 at 10:00, when we would return it to your garage. We would also appreciate it if the vehicle could be collected from your premises and returned with one of your chauffeurs driving. I have attached a copy of my driving licence, as per your requirements.

Best wishes,
Quentin Corbyngton
